# 🪪 AGR-130 · `forensic-investigation-blackboard`

> Specialists contribute independently to shared evidence; a controller decides when the picture closes.

| Card ID | Domain | Pattern | Nodes | Edges | Verifiers | Routers | Max steps | Risk surface |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `AGR-130` | security | **blackboard** | 3 | 3 | 1 | 0 | 40 | execute |

> 🎯 **Requires a goal** — the incident to investigate and the question the investigation must settle. Without one the graph refuses and runs no node.

flowchart LR

Legend: `[/…/]` router · `{{…}}` verifier · `[…]` worker/agent node.

## What it does

Specialists contribute to shared evidence; a controller decides when it closes.

## Why it should deliver results

Specialists contribute independently to shared evidence and a controller decides when the picture is closed enough to act on. Suited to open-ended investigation, where the next useful question depends on what the last contributor found. Open questions are listed rather than quietly dropped.

- **Exit contract** — conclusions cite evidence; unresolved questions are stated, not dropped
- **Machine-checked** — `output.uncited_claims == 0`
- **Machine-checked** — `output.open_questions is not None`
- **Bounded** — hard stop after 40 steps; every loop edge is condition-guarded
- **Golden cases** — `uv run agr eval forensic-investigation-blackboard` replays recorded cases through the real edge/assert logic (mock runner proves mechanics; `--live` measures your model)
- **Trace gallery** — [every case's route, node outputs, and checked asserts](../../../docs/traces/forensic-investigation-blackboard.md)

## How to work with it

```bash
uv run agr show forensic-investigation-blackboard       # full definition
uv run agr profile forensic-investigation-blackboard    # deterministic structural facts
uv run agr mermaid forensic-investigation-blackboard    # regenerate the diagram below
uv run agr eval forensic-investigation-blackboard       # run golden cases (add --live for your endpoint)
uv run agr adapt forensic-investigation-blackboard --target langgraph > app.py   # compile to runnable LangGraph
uv run agr optimize forensic-investigation-blackboard   # propose bounded structural improvements (dry-run)
```

Over MCP: `uv run agr mcp` exposes the registry (search / show / profile) to any MCP client.
To evolve it: `uv run agr infuse forensic-investigation-blackboard <node> <ability>` — every mutation is gate-checked and appended to the graph's lineage log.

## Edge logic

| From | To | Condition |
|---|---|---|
| `seed` | `investigate` | always |
| `assess` | `investigate` | len(open_questions) > 0 and attempts < 3 |
| `investigate` | `assess` | always |
